decision.summary: A multi-sample downward offset in E and U begins around index 435, stabilizes by ~440, and persists through index 449 without recovery within the allowed context [400, 485]. The absence of an opposing return before index 485 prevents confirmation of a temporary interval; status is uncertain. N shows only minor correlated noise, insufficient to confirm a 3D transient.

intervals.observation: E and U show a sustained downward offset beginning near index 435, reaching a stable low plateau by ~440 and persisting through 449; N remains noisy with no coherent opposing motion. Return to pre-offset level is not observed within allowed context (ends at 485), and the offset does not reverse before index 485.
